children: unveiled its newest artificial intelligence model on Tuesday, Claude Opus 5.5, which it says is capable of the same-level of performance of Claude Fable 5.1 and is cheaper than its Opus 5 model.
“On our automated behavioral audit, the most comprehensive alignment test we run, Opus 5.5 is the strongest-performing model we’ve tested to date,” Anthropic said on its website.
that Anthropic was getting ready to release a new AI model.
The AI frontier lab said Claude Opus 5.5 is good at finding and fixing inefficiencies in software, noting that it succeeded in 39 out of 40 times in cutting load times across every page of a web app.

It also has strong safety scores, Anthropic added, noting it has the best scores of any model to date on our automated behavioral audit. “It is much less likely than recent models to take hard-to-reverse actions or act outside the boundaries it’s been given, and it’s more resistant than Opus 5 to prompt injection,” Anthropic added.
Claude Opus 5.5 also has similar skills in biology and cybersecurity to Claude Mythos 5.1, so it will have similar safeguards to its Claude Fable 5.1 model, Anthropic explained.

In addition to its capabilities, Claude Opus 5.5 is 40% cheaper than Opus 5, with input and output tokens costs $4 and $20 per million, respectively. Cache reads are $0.20 per million tokens, 60% cheaper than Opus 5, Anthropic added.

Claude Opus 5.5 is also 30% faster than Opus 5 and it will have a longer-time limit usage on Pro, Max, and Team plans, Anthropic said. The company also said it would give subscribers a rate limit reset, which they can now save and use whenever they choose.
